content: <thought>The workflow is: retrieve TiO₂ bulk (mp-2657), generate slabs for (1,1,1) with required thickness/vacuum, select the first slab, retrieve CO₂ molecule (mp-644607), find adsorption sites on the slab, select the first ontop site, place CO₂ at height 2.0 Å, save the combined structure to a CIF file, and output its path.
